item.title: PennDOT Reduces Speed Limit on I-81 in Schuylkill County Due to Winter Weather
item.description: PennDOT has reduced the speed limits on Interstate 81 in Schuylkill County due to weather conditions.As of 9:15pm, Saturday, winter weather on I-81 has reduced speed limits between Interstate 78 interchange in Lebanon County to the Interstate 80 interchange in Luzerne County. The speed limit has been reduced to 45 miles per hour.
